checkpoints.description: [1/4] Pre-register ADR-006 and add failing tests for eigenvector extraction and mode perturbation

impact_assessment.why: Both known Hopfion candidates are saddles (14d min -5.799863, 14e min -2.600799). A negative Hessian mode gives a principled descent direction; perturbing along it and relaxing may reach a nearby local minimum, which is the natural next test for claim 14b.
impact_assessment.benefits: A bounded, pre-registered search that either finds numerical local-minimum evidence for 14b or shows that the saddles do not lead to a stable nearby candidate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: claim 14b can rise only to NUMERIC at N=64, never a proof; dependency: scipy eigsh and JAX already declared; concurrency: single writer; state: one result file; cost: candidate build + 1 eigenvector + 2 perturb-relax-Hessian attempts, about 7 minutes under the 900 s cap
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the validated tangent operator; normalize each mode to unit interior RMS and use pre-registered eps=0.05 and 0.15; accept a relaxed candidate only if H>0.9 and force RMS<0.05; compute the Hessian only for accepted candidates; abort/time-check against G-003

checkpoints.description: [3/4] Saddle-escape from the pure-FN candidate: eps 0.05/0.15 collapse to H=0.320365/0.237385, max bond 1.967/1.994, force 6.8e-3/7.6e-3; neither passes H>0.9; no local minimum; 14b UNVERIFIED; 167.9 s

[1/4] Pre-register ADR-007 for a box-length scan of the pure-FN candidate Hessian

impact_assessment.why: The pure-FN candidate at length 10 is a saddle (min -2.600799) and its escape collapses. The box length sets the soliton-to-boundary ratio and the virial balance, so a different length may admit a local minimum; this has never been scanned.
impact_assessment.benefits: A four-point length scan either finds a numerical local minimum for claim 14b or shows the saddle is not a length-10 artifact, both inside one G-003 process.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: claim 14b can rise only to NUMERIC at N=64, never a proof; dependency: none beyond JAX/scipy; concurrency: single writer; state: one result file; cost: four 1200-step N=64 relaxations plus up to four 8-mode Hessians, about 8 minutes under the 900 s cap
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register lengths 8, 10, 12, 14; accept a field for a Hessian only if H>0.9 and force RMS<0.05; stop at the first local minimum; reuse the validated tangent operator and the -1e-6 tolerance; time-check against G-003

checkpoints.description: [3/4] Length scan L=8,10,12,14: all keep H>0.9 but every Hessian has 8 negative modes (min -1.469962, -2.600799, -4.223930, -6.669667); no local minimum; 14b UNVERIFIED; 383.5 s

[1/4] Pre-register ADR-008 and add failing tests for the vortex-knot mass hypothesis

impact_assessment.why: The user direction is that particles are vortices in a fluid. The simplest falsifiable realization assigns the three charged leptons to the lowest torus knots T(2,3), T(2,5), T(2,7) with mass proportional to the thin-filament Biot-Savart energy at fixed core radius.
impact_assessment.benefits: A parameter-free test of the vortex-particle idea against the observed charged-lepton hierarchy and the Koide Q=2/3 relation; a negative result identifies the hierarchy mechanism a viable model must add.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new claim 17, no existing claim changes; dependency: numpy only; concurrency: none; state: one result file; numerical: the thin-filament energy is a regularized proxy, so the scaling argument is reported alongside the numbers
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use a fixed core radius, fixed torus geometry and closed curves; report both length and energy ratios and the power p required to match the data; falsify only the simplest assignment, not the general fluid-vortex idea

checkpoints.description: [3/4] Vortex knots T(2,3),T(2,5),T(2,7): energy ratios 1:1.4379:1.9427 vs observed 1:206.77:3477.37; Koide Q 0.3393 vs 2/3; required power p=12.28; claim 17 FALSIFIED; result/docs updated

[1/4] Pre-register ADR-009 and add failing tests for one-parameter vortex cascade spectra

impact_assessment.why: Claim 17 shows the thin-filament knot spectrum is too compressed. A viable vortex model needs a hierarchy mechanism; the simplest are a geometric cascade m_n ~ lambda^n and a power law m_n ~ (n+1)^p. Each has one shape parameter and therefore predicts the tau ratio and Koide Q from the muon ratio.
impact_assessment.benefits: A parameter-free test of whether a single fluid hierarchy can explain both the charged-lepton ratios and Q=2/3, or whether a Z3/circulant coupling is required.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new claim 18, no existing claim changes; dependency: numpy only; concurrency: none; state: one result file; numerical: the power-law root for Q=2/3 is found by bisection
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register the 10% ratio and 0.01 Q tolerances; report both the muon-fit and Q-fit predictions; do not add a second parameter to rescue the fit

checkpoints.description: [3/4] One-parameter hierarchies: geometric tau ratio 42753 (11.3x high, Q=0.871); power law muon fit +34.5% tau (Q=0.696); power law Q fit -32.5% tau; no model matches both; claim 18 FALSIFIED

[1/4] Pre-register ADR-010 and add failing tests for the real Z3 rotor with a second harmonic and flux

impact_assessment.why: Claim 5c shows the real cos(3 phi) rotor has E1=E2. The user direction is a changed potential; test whether a real Z3-symmetric potential plus a fractional flux can reach Koide Q=2/3, or whether the near-degeneracy is generic.
impact_assessment.benefits: A bounded scan that either finds a viable real-potential shape or establishes that a phase/complex structure or a different mass mapping is required.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new claim 19, no existing claim changes; dependency: numpy only; concurrency: none; state: one result file; numerical: Fourier truncation at n_cut=120 must be checked for the deep-well cases
impact_assessment.mitigation: Scan mu=1, nu in {0,1,3,10}, flux in 0..1; check n_cut convergence at the best point; pre-register the 2/3 - 0.01 threshold; record the exact degeneracy at zero flux
